music.notes: Harmony changes on every city cut; the glockenspiel plays one note per Polaroid landing (29.7 + 0.15 i). High-passed at 55 Hz to keep the low end light.

sfx.role: a soft pen gliding as each caption is written; one length per caption
sfx.source: code-original, audio/sfx.py: pinkish noise band-passed 500-3200 Hz, raised-cosine stroke swells, no grain modulation, no gaps (rev. 2 after the user found rev. 1 jagged)

sfx.role: construction lines sketched during the engine's build

fallbackReason: No recorded sound library is installed on this machine and the stock sites need interactive downloads; pen, paper and desk sounds were synthesised instead, the click and typing sounds are the skill's built-ins.
listening: Not auditioned: checked by numbers only (spectrogram, band energy, LUFS, true peak, per-cue SFX vs music peaks).
revision: 2026-11-21 rev 2: the pen was rebuilt as a smooth glide. Near-silent gaps dropped from about 25% to 0%, the spectral centroid from about 6 kHz to 3.5 kHz, and envelope grit (20-300 Hz) from 0.34 to about 0.2.
